yaml:
path: /kaggle/input/posture-keypoints-detection
train: images/train # train images (relative to 'path')
val: images/val # val images (relative to 'path') 
test: images/val

# Keypoints
kpt_shape: [4, 3] # number of keypoints, number of dims (2 for x,y or 3 for x,y,visible)
flip_idx: [0, 1, 2, 3]

# Classes dictionary
names:
    0: person
rights_limitation: Numerous images visibly from iStock/Freepik; uploader license does not independently prove underlying photo permissions.
visual_scope: All 300 contact-sheet images inspected. Mixture of standing, sitting, crouching, floor poses and some silhouettes; selected chair-sitting photos can supplement forward/head-down/back leaning, few clear lateral lean examples. No five-class labels.
